words.ex: Dad works on his computer at home.
words.ex_zh: 爸爸在家用電腦工作。

words.ex: She takes her laptop to the coffee shop.
words.ex_zh: 她帶著筆電去咖啡店。

words.ex: Grandma reads news on her tablet.
words.ex_zh: 奶奶用平板看新聞。

words.ex: Almost everyone has a smartphone now.
words.ex_zh: 現在幾乎人人都有智慧型手機。

words.ex: Don't watch the screen for too long.
words.ex_zh: 不要盯著螢幕太久。

words.ex: I type fast on the keyboard.
words.ex_zh: 我用鍵盤打字很快。

words.ex: I use the internet to learn English.
words.ex_zh: 我用網路學英文。

words.ex: This website teaches free math lessons.
words.ex_zh: 這個網站教免費的數學課。

words.ex: We played an online game together.
words.ex_zh: 我們一起玩線上遊戲。

words.ex: I downloaded a new app yesterday.
words.ex_zh: 我昨天下載了一個新的應用程式。

words.ex: She uploaded the photos to the cloud.
words.ex_zh: 她把照片上傳到雲端。

words.ex: Never tell anyone your password.
words.ex_zh: 絕對不要告訴任何人你的密碼。

words.ex: She sends me a message every night.
words.ex_zh: 她每天晚上傳訊息給我。

words.ex: I got an email from my teacher.
words.ex_zh: 我收到老師寄來的電子郵件。

words.ex: Call me when you arrive home.
words.ex_zh: 到家時打電話給我。

words.ex: We had a video call with Grandpa.
words.ex_zh: 我們和爺爺視訊通話。

words.ex: Please send me the photo.
words.ex_zh: 請把照片傳給我。

words.ex: He didn't reply to my message.
words.ex_zh: 他沒有回覆我的訊息。

words.ex: We watched a funny movie last night.
words.ex_zh: 我們昨晚看了一部好笑的電影。

words.ex: My little sister loves cartoons.
words.ex_zh: 我妹妹超愛卡通。

words.ex: This TV program is about wild animals.
words.ex_zh: 這個電視節目是關於野生動物。

words.ex: He has a cooking channel online.
words.ex_zh: 他在網路上有一個烹飪頻道。

words.ex: The cat video made everyone laugh.
words.ex_zh: 那支貓咪影片讓大家都笑了。

words.ex: I listen to music when I draw.
words.ex_zh: 我畫畫時聽音樂。

words.ex: We play video games on Saturday.
words.ex_zh: 我們星期六玩電玩。

words.ex: I finally passed level ten!
words.ex_zh: 我終於過了第十關！

words.ex: My game character is a brave knight.
words.ex_zh: 我的遊戲角色是一位勇敢的騎士。

words.ex: You control the car with two buttons.
words.ex_zh: 你用兩個按鈕控制車子。

words.ex: The racing game is really exciting.
words.ex_zh: 這款賽車遊戲真的很刺激。

words.ex: This show is boring. Let's go outside.
words.ex_zh: 這節目好無聊，我們出去吧。

words.ex: Be careful with strangers online.
words.ex_zh: 對網路上的陌生人要小心。

words.ex: Don't give your address to a stranger.
words.ex_zh: 不要把地址給陌生人。

words.ex: Your password is private information.
words.ex_zh: 你的密碼是私人資訊。

words.ex: Is this news real or fake?
words.ex_zh: 這則新聞是真的還是假的？

words.ex: That photo looks fake to me.
words.ex_zh: 那張照片我看起來是假的。

words.ex: You can report bad messages in the app.
words.ex_zh: 你可以在應用程式裡檢舉不當訊息。

words.ex: Turn off the TV before you sleep.
words.ex_zh: 睡前把電視關掉。

words.ex: Outdoor activities are good for your eyes.
words.ex_zh: 戶外活動對眼睛很好。

words.ex: Keep a balance between games and study.
words.ex_zh: 在遊戲和讀書之間保持平衡。

words.ex: I spend one hour online every day.
words.ex_zh: 我每天花一小時上網。

words.ex: My screen time limit is two hours.
words.ex_zh: 我的螢幕時間限制是兩小時。

words.ex: Let's play cards instead of watching TV.
words.ex_zh: 我們改玩紙牌，不要看電視吧。
